title: In vitro reconstruction of site-specifically phosphorylated RNA Pol II for transcription regulator recruitment
author: Hardtke, Moreno, et al.

steps.title: Culture HEK293 cells
steps.instruction: Grow enough HEK293 cells for the pull‑down: ~200 × 10⁶ cells (≈6 confluent T175 flasks) per experiment, with a minimum of 50 × 10⁶ cells per sample and up to four samples per pull‑down; seed one extra flask for viability counting.

steps.title: Detach cells from culture
steps.instruction: Remove medium, wash with sterile 1× PBS at 20‑22 °C, add Trypsin‑EDTA, incubate at 37 °C for ≤2 min, verify detachment microscopically, quench with DMEM complete media (total volume ≤50 mL), then pellet cells by centrifugation for 5 min at 200 g at 20‑22 °C.

steps.title: Wash and collect cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL ice‑cold sterile 1× PBS, transfer to a 2 mL tube, centrifuge 5 min at 200 g at 4 °C, record the packed cell volume (PCV, typically ~1 mL) for later washes, discard supernatant, resuspend again in 1 mL ice‑cold sterile 1× PBS for a second wash; if proceeding directly to nuclear extraction, keep the pellet as is. Freeze at –20 °C if extraction will not be immediate (use immediately when possible).

steps.title: Prepare eluted proteins for LC‑MS/MS
steps.instruction: Take the eluted proteins (from the prior pull‑down) and separate them on a 75 µm × 25 cm Acclaim PepMap100 C‑18 column (Thermo Scientific). Analyze online by nano‑electrospray ionization tandem MS on a Thermo Scientific Fusion Tribrid Orbitrap. Acquire MS1 scans at high resolution and MS2 scans in the ion trap in rapid‑scan mode with collision‑induced dissociation. Identify proteins with Proteome Discoverer 2.3 against the human UniProt reference proteome, applying a 1 % false‑discovery rate and calculate z‑scores for changes between control and kinase‑treated samples as described by Floyd et al.

steps.title: Process proteomics data
steps.instruction: Impute missing values for the two control replicates and two kinase‑treated replicates, then quantile‑normalize and log₂‑transform the data. Perform two‑tailed t‑tests; define significantly enriched proteins as those with p ≤ 0.05. Generate a volcano plot of log₂ fold change versus –log₁₀ p‑value using GraphPad Prism (v10.2.3). Refer to the supplementary table for expected results.
